methodology: Only Comune F205/MILANO and school degree containing INFANZIA from the official MIM CSVs.
Identity precedence: explicit reviewed crosswalk; existing curated mechanographic code; unique normalized address; unique street-token subset plus civic, with compatible management.
Reviewed crosswalks with conflicting addresses are provisional identity associations, except Borsi supported by the previous curated former-site reference; neither is a confirmed current entrance.
No school closure is inferred from an absent MIM match.
MIM-only records have no invented coordinates, neighborhood or municipality. They are not labelled as newly opened.
Address conflicts preserve both source values and withhold historical coordinates; source mismatch is not assumed to be a confirmed transfer.
Existing detailed research is preserved with its original check date; no 2027/28 prices, rules or public deadlines are asserted.
